items.headline: US Futures Mixed as Fed Meeting Begins and Earnings Season Continues
items.summary: US stock futures are mixed this Tuesday as investors weigh ongoing earnings reports and the commencement of the Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting. Markets closed higher on Monday, October 26, largely boosted by positive sentiment around new artificial intelligence IPO filings. The Fed's interest rate decision is highly anticipated for Wednesday, October 28.

items.headline: Celestica Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Celestica ($CLS) saw its shares rise over 15% in pre-market trading, driven by its third-quarter 2026 results which significantly beat expectations. The company reported an 83% year-over-year increase in revenue and raised its full-year guidance.

items.headline: UPS Climbs After Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
items.summary: United Parcel Service ($UPS) shares were up 1.58% in premarket trading after the shipping giant reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $1.69 on revenue of $22.9 billion, surpassing Wall Street expectations, and subsequently raised its full-year guidance.

items.headline: Royal Caribbean Cruises Higher on Strong Q3 Performance
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Group ($RCL) reported third-quarter 2026 Adjusted EPS of $6.57, outperforming its guidance due to robust close-in demand and reduced costs. The company also increased its full-year Adjusted EPS outlook to a range of $17.85 to $17.95.

items.headline: Verizon Falls on Mixed Earnings
items.summary: Verizon ($VZ) shares tumbled 3.5% after reporting mixed third-quarter 2026 results. While the company's adjusted earnings of $1.31 per share were ahead of estimates, its total operating revenues of $34.31 billion missed consensus expectations.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Kicks Off Two-Day Policy Meeting
items.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) commenced its two-day policy meeting today, October 27. The market widely anticipates that the Fed will maintain the federal funds rate at its current range of 3.75% to 4.0% when the decision is announced on Wednesday, October 28. However, many investors believe a December rate hike remains likely.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Releases Today
items.summary: A series of economic reports are scheduled for release today, including September's Advance Durable Goods Orders and New Home Sales data, as well as October's Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index and regional manufacturing surveys. The weekly ADP NER Pulse, for the four weeks ending October 10, indicated that U.S. private employers added an average of 16,750 jobs per week, showing a slowdown in hiring for the second consecutive week.

items.headline: Major Companies Report Earnings
items.summary: Earnings season is in full swing, with several major companies reporting today. Before the market open, Royal Caribbean Group ($RCL), UPS ($UPS), PayPal Holdings ($PYPL), and Novartis ($NVS) released their third-quarter results. Key companies expected to report after market close include Visa ($V), Seagate Technology ($STX), Waste Management ($WM), and Robinhood ($HOOD).

items.headline: Sector Dynamics Shift as AI Stocks Face Rotation
items.summary: While AI-related developments, such as an IPO filing by Anthropic, bolstered market sentiment on Monday, a notable trend in October indicates a rotation of capital. The S&P 500 index excluding AI stocks has outperformed the broader S&P 500 by over 6% this month, suggesting investors are moving towards more diversified or value-oriented market segments.

items.headline: Oil Prices Remain a Market Factor
items.summary: Crude oil prices, while trading under $110 per barrel today, remain a significant macro trend affecting markets. Geopolitical developments and ongoing efforts to ease conflicts are closely watched by commodity investors.
